ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the background with approximately 35-40% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white rings and mottled blobs distributed across both lobes. Clusters are most dense on the proximal and medial sections of the left lobe and the central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate vertex angle of 62 degrees and a depth roughly 20% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable high-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) located on the distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly concave sweep along the trailing edges transitioning into a sharp convex curve at the outermost lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense population of circular, high-contrast white rings (rosettes) ranging from 5 to 25 pixels in diameter across the entire visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned vertical linear marks detected on the lower central portion of the left lobe, partially occluded by rosette patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, pervasive scarring from barnacle colonization across all visible quadrants; significant jagged irregularities and potential small notches along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptional density of circular scar patterns creating a distinct 'honeycomb' texture on approximately 50% of the visible fluke area.
